text: すごい　ポケモンを　もっているんだね

structure.jp: すごい　ポケモンを

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a state that is going on now. もっている = 'you have (with you)'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives the feeling of 'I see that...' or 'it's that...'. もっているんだね = 'so you have them, don't you'.
